name: menata-vendure-deploy
description: Minimal production deployment for the Menata Vendure store. Consumes @vendure/* from npm (precompiled) instead of building the monorepo fork. Plugins are shared from ../plugins (single source).
//: Version ranges (~3.5.0) auto-track upstream patch/minor so pulling official Vendure keeps working without edits. Bump the minor (e.g. ~3.6.0) only on a major upstream jump.
//overrides: Pin the TanStack Router family to the versions the monorepo resolves (1.157.16). Newer releases tighten route-id parsing and break the dashboard's bundled routes. The committed package-lock.json freezes the rest.
